info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Consumer Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Consumer Service Configuration API allows businesses to update configuration settings for consumer services based on specific parameters. This API facilitates adjustments to brokered products identified by 'param1', ensuring that services remain aligned with business requirements. Typical consumers of this API include application developers and service administrators who need to fine-tune service offerings or respond to market changes. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance the adaptability of their consumer-facing services, ensuring they meet evolving customer needs.

patch.description: Allows for the modification of specific attributes of a brokered product identified by the given product ID. This operation is essential for maintaining accurate product information and ensuring that any updates to the product details are reflected in the system.

requestBody.description: Updates the information for the specified brokered product. This operation allows you to modify existing details of the product identified by PROD-700045.
